test.name: Routes to question-selection when objective exists but no questions
test.description: Routing table row 1: research.json has an objective but zero questions. The router must invoke Skill('question-selection') to derive the first question. Uses empty-project-just-created, which has only an objective and tree — the cleanest R1 state. question-selection is stubbed (bare deny) because the router does not read its return value; it re-enters the routing loop after the callee finishes.

input.user_message: Research the next open question on this project — drive the workflow forward.

judge_context: This is a ROUTING test. The only assertion that matters is whether Skill('question-selection') is the first Skill call. A deterministic validator (test_routes_to_expected_skill) owns that check — do not grade the routing decision yourself.
The project has an objective but no questions yet. The routing table's first applicable row is 'Objective but no questions -> question-selection'. Any other first Skill call is wrong.

question-selection is stubbed and returns a bare denial with 'do not retry'. The router may attempt a second routing pass; that is expected behavior, not a defect. Grade only the quality of the router's own work: state derivation, logging, and narration.
Do not penalize the router for not completing the full research cycle — the stub prevents meaningful progress beyond the first routing decision.
